plan.signal: first at most 90 seconds, mono channel 0, polyphase resampling to 8 kHz
plan.metric: mean magnitude-squared Welch coherence, 300-3000 Hz, nperseg 2048, overlap 1024
plan.decision: metadata-name match (or explicitly audited filename anomaly), mean coherence >= 0.20 and >= 3x highest other-source coherence
plan.retention: unconfirmed audio stays quarantined; never select source pairs using ASR performance
